facts.fact: A Ministry of Health project, begun December 2025 and running to March 2027 with GIZ and HISP UNIMA, is deploying climate and health tools on the DHIS2-based HMIS and One Health surveillance platform and facilitating interoperability with the WHO-supported national EWARS system, initially in four districts.
facts.system: DHIS2-based HMIS, One Health Surveillance Platform and national EWARS interoperability

systems.system: Early Warning, Alert and Response (EWARS) system
